notes: Adds real chat attachments while preserving the complete 1.6.4 A.C.E. runtime. Attach PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF images and Word, PowerPoint, PDF, Excel, text and related files by picker, drag/drop or paste. DOCX/PPTX/XLSX and text-bearing files are extracted locally; DOC/RTF use macOS textutil; PDFs use pdftotext when present with a macOS PDFKit fallback. Images are analyzed locally through the active Ollama vision-capable model before the normal A.C.E. response. Attachment state remains scoped to the originating chat. Existing posters, presentations, Preview/Edit, Live preview side panel, downloads/exports, Voice/Pocket TTS, Stop, Chat/Live, projects/history, AI Search and multi-source research are retained from 1.6.4. Release files were syntax-checked and SHA-256 verified from a fresh GitHub checkout. Final hardware/runtime behavior still requires a click-through test on the user's Mac.
